answer_text: A Cisco ASA returns TS_UNACCEPTABLE because it can only handle a single traffic selector (TS) per child SA, while Cato by default sends multiple TS in one proposal. To fix this, configure your Cato account or a specific IPsec IKEv2 site to send each TS in a separate packet. Do this under Site Configuration > Advanced Configuration (or per IPsec IKEv2 site) to enable single-TS packets for interoperability with ASA.
